title: docs(plugin-spec): Plugin Testing teaches bootStack and the in-process handle of @objectstack/verify, not the non-existent @objectstack/testing (#15952)
body:
Part of #15952
Clause-②: no

Docs-only. This PR lands the docs half of #15952; the card stays open for the scaffold half, which is held (see below).

## What changed

**`content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx`, "Plugin Testing"** is the one file in the diff (`git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD`: 1 file, +84 / -62).

- The section is rewritten around what ships. The ghost callout and all seven `@objectstack/testing` / `createTestContext` / `createTestEnvironment` mentions are gone.
- The page is hand-written: it is listed in `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`, and no generator writes it.
- It now covers `bootStack`, the in-process handle (a method table), refusal assertions on `code` and status, a runtime plugin booted through `extraPlugins`, and `bootStackOnce`.
- It uses only handle methods that exist in the published `@objectstack/verify@17.7.0` and on `main`. Each was read from `packages/verify/src/handle.ts` and from the 17.7.0 tarball's README and `.d.ts`.

No changeset: nothing here publishes (`skip-changeset`).

## The scaffold half is held

Branch `claude/issue-15952-scaffold-held`, at `812d8dbf94`, keeps the full implementation. It has no PR of its own. It contains:
- the blank template's `test` script, `@objectstack/verify` + `vitest` devDependencies, `vitest.config.ts` and the one starter test `note.test.ts`;
- `create-objectstack`'s template exclude;
- the Scaffold E2E `test` step;
- the `create-objectstack` minor changeset.

On that head a freshly scaffolded app runs `pnpm test` green. The half is held, on the seat's order on the card, for two measured reasons:

1. **#22912: `npm install` of a vitest-4 project crashes on npm 10 (upstream).** Node 22's bundled npm 10.9.x fails with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`. The one-line repro is a manifest holding only `"vitest": "^4.0.0"`. Shipping the starter's vitest devDependency would break `npm install` for the blank starter on Node 22. The half resumes when #22912's one-line manifest installs on npm 10.
2. **Open question 1 on #15952: two required repo gates count the template payload test as `create-objectstack`'s own suite.** The gates are `check-registry-log-declared` and `check:test-source-alias`. Both walk every `*.test.ts` under a package without the tsconfig `exclude` payload boundary that `check-undeclared-dep-imports` already reads, and both exited 1 at `812d8dbf94`. That question is deferred with the held half.

## Verification (head `dfead30310`)

- **Acceptance grep:** `git grep -n "objectstack/testing" -- content/ skills/ packages/` finds 0 hits (exit 1). The three-symbol expression `objectstack/testing\|createTestContext\|createTestEnvironment` also finds 0 hits (exit 1). Before, at `9fdb12752c`, there were 7 hits, all in this page.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` was derived with no paths at `dfead30310`: 40 families. All 40 were run, plus `check-registry-log-declared` and `check:test-source-alias`, the two that were red with the payload test, and every one exited 0. `--ran` reconciles 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **Anchors:** `check:doc-anchors` resolves every internal `#fragment` link, including the section's new `#runtime-contract` link.

## Acceptance notes

- The published skills still teach a hand-assembled `LiteKernel` test (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`, and `references/plugin-development.md` under "Testing Plugins"). None mentions `@objectstack/testing`, so the acceptance grep is clean. Pointing them at `bootStack` is a governed (Tier H) `skills/**` edit.
